$comment: What every hub installs. include: every subfolder of these folders that holds a bb plugin is installed (so adding a plugin is just adding a folder). exclude: folders to leave out. plugins: extra entries, e.g. from another public repo ({ "path", "repo"?, "ref"? }). marketplace: plugins from bb's marketplaces ({ "id", "marketplace"?, "source"? }); manage them with `bb hub marketplace add/remove`. syncIntervalMinutes (5-1440): the shared sync interval; every hub syncs at the same UTC-aligned times.
